nonTimeTrialClip.observations: Regular Neo Bowser City race with Wendy, item roulette, score/combo display and lap 1/2. No time-trial timer or completed race result. Six overview frames at 0, 5, 10, 15, 20 and 25 seconds visually reviewed.
nonTimeTrialClip.liveContext: Astre shared a manual-steering demonstration; adjacent messages say they noticed issues in multiplayer, tested solo and enabled touch display. These are author claims; clip alone does not establish update causality.

limitations: Four full-run videos were verified previously; this review adds live sharing context and hash validation, not a new full-footage review.
Source publication dates are retained separately from video-sharing dates and do not assert race-completion instants.
All other October source rows and the full 2019–2026 history remain incomplete; live website deployment is unverified.
